title_as_printed: Ostwald coefficients of argon solubility in water in the temperature range 3-28 C
pressure_note: Ostwald coefficient defined 'cm3 of gas at T / cm3 of water at T (at total pressure 1 atm)'; gas saturated with solvent vapour by bubbling through water, pressure brought to 1 atm

value.what: Ostwald coefficient of argon in pure water; printed value is gamma x 10^3
value.volume_basis_evidence: cm3 of gas at T / cm3 of water at T (at total pressure 1 atm); pure water so solvent and solution volumes coincide

volume_basis_evidence: cm3 of gas at T / cm3 of water at T (at total pressure 1 atm)
conversion_needs: Ostwald coefficient to mole fraction needs water density and the gas molar volume at T; the paper does not define 'standard conditions' for gas volumes (the Ostwald coefficient uses gas volume at T and 1 atm, so none is needed)
pressure 1 atm total (includes water vapour per the text); partial pressure of argon not given
notes: Wide layout in the paper (t row and gamma row, 9 columns); restacked to long form, one row per temperature, left to right. Printed mid-dot decimals (2-9, 34-7 etc. in the scan text layer) written with full stop. Solvent outgassed thoroughly; stated overall precision 0.2 %.
